_comment: Social wall. Each platform renders behind a tab; 'All' shows them side by side and is hidden when only one platform is configured. Facebook uses the official Page Plugin, which needs no app id or token - just the page URL, which must be a PAGE (a personal profile cannot be embedded). Instagram profile FEEDS cannot be embedded without a Business account and a Meta access token, so list individual post URLs in 'posts' (single-post embeds still work without a token) or leave it empty and the tab shows a link instead. Set enabled:false to hide a platform.
note: Follow the conference on Facebook and Instagram.
